name: Academic Skills Center
description: The mission of Dartmouth's Academic Skills Center is to assist students in achieving their academic goals. The Academic Skills Center accomplishes its mission through a variety of services and programs. We help students improve their academic skills and ability to learn, thereby maximizing their academic experience and allowing them to achieve greater academic performance and personal fulfillment. The Center continuously works to develop services and programs to reach an increasingly diverse and changing student population. In promoting and furthering students' intellectual skills and helping

name: Advancing Indigenous Science and Engineering Society
Aegis
description: The Aegis is Dartmouth College’s award winning yearbook. The Aegis yearbook is dedicated to capturing the beauty of Dartmouth. In our attempts to fill the book's pages with the passions, experiences, and perspectives of the students at the College, we help save a bit of what Dartmouth is every year. All students are welcome to join regardless of past experience or class year! Students can be involved with the photography, layout, or business teams of putting the book together.

name: Alaska Native Cultural Committee
description: The Alaska Native Cultural Committee's mission is to provide the Alaska Native students on campus with a community and a way to share/celebrate their cultures.

name: Allen House
description: Provide a residential community to support students academically, mentally, and socially in their journey at Dartmouth.

name: Allied Scholars for Animal Protection
description: Some of our goals include setting up film screenings, tabling events, and guest lectures in order to bring awareness of the practices of the animal agriculture industry and the environmental and health benefits of a plant-based lifestyle to the Dartmouth community.

name: Amarna
description: Amarna, one of two Undergraduate Societies on campus, is a coed residential social organization. We are open and non-exclusive, with no rush and no pledge period for new members. We embrace, affirm and appreciate individuality and diversity with respect to gender, race, color, ethnicity, class, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, and lifestyle. We promote a strong sense of community among our members through mutual respect and support. We encourage a spirit of voluntary, not obligatory, participation in house activities. We plan and hold a variety of events, from dance p

name: American Cancer Society: Dartmouth Undergraduate Chapter
description: The American Cancer Society: Dartmouth Undergraduate Chapter is dedicated to uniting students in the fight against cancer through advocacy, philanthropy, and community support. Our mission is to engage the student body through impactful initiatives, awareness campaigns, and fundraising events that support cancer patients and research. By collaborating with campus organizations and communities in the Upper Valley, we strive to educate, inspire, and mobilize students to make a meaningful difference. Together, we are committed to fostering a campus culture of compassion, action, and hope in the f

name: American Conservation Coalition
description: To facilitate robust environmental dialogue and action at Dartmouth through market environmentalism education and local stewardship.

name: American Society of Mechanical Engineering Dartmouth College Student Section
description: Advance and complement Dartmouth engineers’ experience by providing students with meaningful professional experiences through connections with peers, faculty, industry, and other organizations; educational and technical events; and community and service. The organization aims to support engineers in creating a better world for humanity and its other inhabitants

name: AMP - Alcohol Management Program
description: The Alcohol Management Program (AMP) provides guidance for recognized Dartmouth undergraduate student organization events where alcohol is served. Its success depends upon the cooperative efforts of students, faculty, administration and alumni in both understanding and upholding the spirit of personal responsibility and respect for self and others that is embodied in AMP Policy.

name: Arab Student Association
description: Fostering a vibrant forum for individuals interested in Arab language, culture, and politics at Dartmouth College. As the Arab Student Association (ASA), we are committed to creating a nonpartisan space where members can unite and empower the Arab community through diverse cultural, social, and service events. Our overarching goal is to establish an inclusive "home away from home" for all members while promoting, celebrating, and raising awareness of Arab culture.

name: Asian American Studies Collective
description: The Asian American Studies Collective aims to foster a community of Dartmouth students who are passionate about Asian American Studies and empower our members to advocate for the implementation of Asian American Studies on campus and beyond. Beyond the establishment of an Asian American Studies program, we also aim to facilitate necessary and ongoing conversations about Asian American issues and create a space for collective healing and community-building.

name: Association of Latino Professionals For America
description: The mission of the Association of Latino Professionals For America(ALPFA) at Dartmouth College is to empower and develop Latino men and women and other identifying individuals as leaders of character for the nation, in every sector of the global economy.

name: Badminton Club
description: To provide a safe and welcoming space for all interested in playing badminton, in line with Dartmouth College Athletic Department's commitment to provide athletic opportunities that meet the talents, interests, and needs of a broad range of individuals.

name: Beyond the Athlete
description: At Beyond the Athlete, we are dedicated to providing a supportive environment for athletes navigating the complexities of transitioning away from their sport, whether permanently or temporarily. We understand the profound feelings of loss, identity shift, and uncertainty that can accompany the end or interruption of an athletic career. Our mission is to serve as a beacon of support, compassion, and exploration, guiding members through the process of grief and transition while igniting their curiosity and passion for new possibilities. Central to our mission is the cultivation of a safe and inc

name: Big Green Student Capital
description: Big Green Student Capital exists to develop each member’s independent analytical and presentation skills through rigorous, industry‑wide global equity pitches—both long and short. Every participant researches not only individual companies but also the broader sector dynamics, macro trends, and competitive landscapes that shape investment theses. In a transparent, feedback‑driven environment, members submit original work, receive detailed critique from peers at all levels of seniority, and iterate their analyses until they meet the Club’s high standards. Outstanding pitches earn visibility on o

name: BlackGen Capital
description: BlackGen Capital serves to provide valuable hands-on experience to minorities who have historically been underrepresented in the financial services industry. The purpose of BlackGen Capital is to break down barriers that have prohibited underrepresented minorities from pursuing successful careers in finance and business by creating an environment where like-minded individuals can learn from & network with each other and by providing effective educational resources that can be leveraged at any time. Our focus is to not only cater to students who already have exposure to this industry but to als

name: Book Club
description: This organization is being founded with the purpose of providing Dartmouth students with a community centered around reading for pleasure. The club aims to encourage members to make time for reading outside of an academic setting, and to foster discussion and love of literature. The club plans to make reading materials accessible to all Dartmouth students by providing books to those in need of financial assistance through COSO support or club fundraising. The club also aims to facilitate and fund speeches and/or discussions with the authors of the books read as the club progresses.

name: Boxing Conditioning Club
description: Our mission is to provide a safe and effective space for members of the Dartmouth community to exercise, socialize, and develop their boxing skills.

name: Bridge USA Dartmouth Student Organization
description: Our mission is to pursue fostering intelligent, meaningful, and constructive discourse on contentious issues at Dartmouth, ensuring students are exposed to a wide array of points of view, and to promote education for the purpose of improving discourse. Rather than encouraging debate for the sake of debate, we hope to encourage students to learn. We hope students can learn both the perspectives of others and where their views may be improved. In this way we hope to approach meaningful solutions to important problems both at Dartmouth and around the world.

name: British Society
description: British Society exists to create a welcoming home at Dartmouth for British students and students who have attended school in Britain, and to share British culture with the wider campus community. We bring together students across all four class years for socials, meals, cultural celebrations, and conversation, so that no British student at Dartmouth feels socially outnumbered or disconnected from the traditions of home, and so that any Dartmouth student curious about British life has an accessible way in.

name: Camp Kesem Dartmouth
description: Camp Kesem Dartmouth provides free summer camps and year-round peer support for children impacted by a parent├óÔé¼Ôäós cancer in the Upper Valley community

name: Can't Sell Culture Comedy Collective
description: We are a comedy collective. Our mission is to generate and showcase comedy to the Dartmouth community from members of the Dartmouth community. We will do so on three separate forms: live performance, written publication, and online publication.

name: Central Americans United Student Association
description: The mission of Central Americans United Student Association is to unify the various communities of Dartmouth College that identify under the Central American identity. We hope to establish a union that is inclusive of all voices, including but not limited to Indigenous, Afrodescendant, Latine and beyond.

name: Cheerleading Team
description: The mission of the Dartmouth Cheerleading team is to create a community of students from all backgrounds through sport. The team prioritizes inclusivity and fun: members buy into a supportive and spirited culture, all working towards the collective goal of cheering on fellow Dartmouth student athletes.

name: Christian Union Vox
description: Christian Union Vox is a Christian leadership development ministry that develops and connects transformative Christian Leaders. As a chapter of the national Christian Union ministry, we seek a nation transformed by the Spirit of God through a network of dynamic, spiritually vibrant Christian leaders. CU Vox is student-led, and coached by a full-time Ministry Director, Pastor Tim Pillsbury. Like Jesus, we welcome students from all backgrounds to explore the Christian faith and build a loving, God-seeking community together. The CU Vox community is tight-knit, loving, and intensely focused on se

name: Club Baseball
description: The specific purposes and objectives of the Dartmouth Club Baseball team are both to pursue personal athletic growth and to foster a strong sense of community through a common interest and passion for the sport of baseball.

name: Club Golf
description: Provide members with opportunities to improve golf skills and compete against both teammates and other schools.

name: Club Squash
description: To provide a safe space for Dartmouth students to exercise, have fun, and engage in a positive community.

name: Club Swimming
description: A. To teach the fundamentals of swimming. B. To allow members to participate and gain experience in the sport. C. To allow members to develop sportsmanship in the sport. D. To allow members of all skill levels to compete in intercollegiate competitions E. To provide coaching and practice for all members. F. To build a strong and competitive swim team.

name: Club Table Tennis
description: At the Dartmouth Table Tennis Club, we seek to provide students of all backgrounds and experience levels the opportunity to play Table Tennis. From beginners who want to learn how to play for the first time, to experienced tournament players, we hope to provide an enriching experience at our club. We pride ourselves in our open environment, seeking to teach players as well as contribute to their improvement within the sport. With this, we hope to help all players pursue table tennis and improve their skills as we strive to be nationally competitive every season and be one of the top programs i

name: Club Tennis
description: Dartmouth Club Tennis is an Organization that fosters meaningful relationships amongst players through consistent practices, competitions, and social events, such as team dinners and end-of-term player award celebration. As a team, it is our mission to create an enjoyable and supportive environment in which all players can share their passion for tennis, and, more importantly, feel comfortable and confident in themselves. As a student-led team, players will learn to plan trips, raise money for the club, and manage the group’s on-campus activities, such as practice and tryouts.

name: Club Water Ski
description: The Dartmouth Water Ski Team shall be designed to provide a competitive environment for a range of interested college students with various skill levels and experience water skiing. The goal of the team will be to promote collegiate waterskiing. This includes participating in team-building and off-water training. The primary objective, however, will be attending the various collegiate waterski events throughout the spring and fall.

name: Collis After Dark
description: To provide late-night social spaces and events every Friday and Saturday throughout the term! Join us for such fun events as: Arcade Night, Pub Trivia, surPRIZE Bingo, Casino Night, and more!

name: Collis Governing Board
description: The Collis Governing Board (CGB) is a student organization that functions to promote community at Dartmouth through the Collis Student Center. CGB initiates programming, co-sponsors and co-hosts events, funds and supports ONE Wheelock, 8 Ball Hall and the Banner Room, enacts facilities improvements, and generally governs student life at Collis.

name: ColorStack @ Dartmouth Student Organization
description: ColorStack's mission is to increase the number of Black and Latinx Computer Science graduates that go on to launch rewarding technical careers. ColorStack at Dartmouth Student Organization is committed to increasing the retention, uplift, and success of Black, LatinX, and Native American students in computing and technology fields. Rooted in the values of community, empowerment, and equity, our chapter builds a supportive network that fosters: (I) Academic growth, (II) professional development, and a strong sense of belonging. This student organization is open to anyone interested in supportin

name: Crafting Circle
description: The mission of Crafting Circle is to continue connecting students with their homelands and Indigenous roots. Crafting, sewing, beading, etc. serve as a spiritual, cultural, and community-driven activity that provides Indigenous students with safe, creative space on Dartmouth's campus. We hold weekly meetings to build community, strengthen individual ties to culture, and to continue the cultural practices of our people. Additionally, we aim to share the knowledges of our homelands with other people in the community.

name: Cycling Team
description: The Dartmouth Cycling Team aims to create a welcoming and inclusive environment for Dartmouth students of all abilities who are interested in training and racing on bikes. We strive to foster a supportive and positive team spirit that celebrates all types of success. The Dartmouth Cycling Team empowers its members to achieve team and individual athletic goals while also providing opportunities for leadership and community involvement.

name: Dartmouth Academic Support Network
description: The Dartmouth Academic Support Network's goal is to create a community of practice for educators who are involved in academic support at Dartmouth to identify challenges and commonalities, share and promote best practices and resources, and work together towards improving the conditions for learning on campus. We are especially focused on supporting the programs and centers that employ and train students to offer peer support.

name: Dartmouth Aerial Arts Student Group
description: DAARTS mission is to create an inclusive space for all body types and athletic/artistic backgrounds to develop strength, confidence, and aerial skills in the context of a rigorous and close knit troupe environment. Some members were in professional children’s circuses. Others were climbers, dancers, and divers. And many have no movement experience. However, we have built a curriculum that integrates students of all levels to learn the basics and then collaborate to create new styles and ways of interacting with the apparatus. DAARTS provides training to members of all levels through careful de

name: Dartmouth Afghan Students Association
description: Afghanistan has been at war for many decades, and the people living there have not experienced and are privileged from most of the opportunities other people have. We as a group of Afghan students and those who care about Afghanistan want to come together, support each other, and build a community trying to have a positive influence on the current situation of Afghanistan that impacts all Afghans across the world. As it is obvious, students coming from Afghanistan see a huge cultural difference when they come to the United States. And people feel better doing things that are more meaningful an

name: Dartmouth Albanian Student Association
description: To provide a space to talk about Albanian culture and heritage.

name: Dartmouth Alliance for Children of Color
Dartmouth Asian Student-Athlete Association
description: As the most underrepresented minority in NCAA athletics, we wanted to start a space open to all but primarily focused on our experience as Asian athletes. We want to enhance the experience of minority athletes and give everyone a space to speak out and connect.

name: Dartmouth Bangladeshi Students Association
description: Raising awareness of Bangladeshi culture through discussion, events, programs, and various other forms of recognition of the Bangladeshi culture

name: Dartmouth Billiards Student Organization
description: The Dartmouth Billiards Student Organization (DBSO) was created to offer interested Dartmouth students the opportunity to pursue their passion for billiards and to compete in both intracollegiate and intercollegiate competitions. By engaging in team training, personalized workshops and competitions, members learn the spirit of working towards goals as a team. We organize intracollegiate tournaments and compete against other universities with competitive billiards programs in the Northeast area. DBSO is committed to being a transparently run organization.

name: Dartmouth Center for Social Impact
description: The Dartmouth Center for Social Impact prepares students to be transformative leaders for the common good. Through community-driven experiential learning, our students cultivate their skills, scholarship, and passion to develop high-impact approaches to the most pressing societal problems. Our graduates go on to lead lives of purpose personally and professionally as social innovators, direct service providers, activists, philanthropists, and community researchers.

name: Dartmouth College Radio
description: The Organization broadcasts and distributes multimedia content focusing on the Dartmouth community and greater Upper Valley as a student-run, non-commercial, non-profit radio station accessible to audiences around the world. Following its history as Dartmouth Broadcasting, the Organization strives to uphold and promote freedom of expression and freedom of information within the Dartmouth community. The Organization develops student voices and creativity by providing students a unique space, platform, and skillset to participate in dialogues of personal, local, and global significance. Through

name: Dartmouth College Student Chapter of Remote Area Medical
description: To give Dartmouth students the chance to participate in Remote Area Medical (RAM) trips focused on providing free services to those who are unable to afford medical care themselves and for those who do not have access to hospitals or healthcare facilities in their area. Through this organization, members will have the opportunity to volunteer and travel to RAM clinics across the nation. This will be an especially valuable learning and leadership experience for aspiring healthcare professionals. This organization will aspire to promote quality healthcare both locally and nationally to the fulle

name: Dartmouth College Undergraduate Acoustic Jam Club
description: The Dartmouth College Undergraduate Acoustic Jam Club aims to create an open, welcoming, and collaborative musical community centered around acoustic jam traditions. We seek to lower the barrier to entry for styles such as bluegrass, old-time, Irish, and Québécois music by fostering an environment where musicians of all skill levels can learn, play, and grow together through shared, participatory music-making.

name: Dartmouth College Undergraduate Chapter of the American Constitution Society
description: The mission of the organization, in line with its national chapter, is to support and advocate for laws and legal systems that redress the founding failures of our Constitution, strengthen our democratic legitimacy, uphold the rule of law, and realize the promise of equality for all, including people of color, women, LGBTQ+ people, people with disabilities, and other historically excluded communities.

name: Dartmouth College Undergraduate Moot Court Team
description: To imbue skills of critical thinking, public speaking, legal analysis, and teamwork within an inclusive cohort of future legal scholars, and to provide hands-on legal education and foster a deep understanding of the justice system and civic responsibility via applying legal skills.

name: Dartmouth Consulting Group
description: We provide pro-bono consulting services to businesses and connect Dartmouth undergraduates with recruiters and professionals in the management consulting industry.

name: Dartmouth Dance Team
description: The primary purpose of the Dartmouth Dance Team is to provide entertainment to the public, promote and uphold college spirit, develop a good sense of sportsmanship among students, and to build better relationships between colleges during all athletic events. Additionally, the Dartmouth Dance Team will engage in collegiate dance competitions at the regional and national levels.

name: Dartmouth Dungeons & Dragons Club
description: The specific purposes and objectives which DDDC is organized to pursue include: To provide a forum for Dartmouth students who are interested in learning and playing the collaborative tabletop role-playing game Dungeons & Dragons (D&D); To bring together a diverse portion of the Dartmouth community, both novice and experienced players, to offer an opportunity for social bonding through the development of the collaborative skills needed to play a tabletop role-playing game with others; To coordinate with other organizations on and off campus to improve the tabletop role-playing community; To est

name: Dartmouth Energy Alliance
description: Dedicated to creating an inclusive space for discussions and experiential learning opportunities related to energy issues.

name: Dartmouth Eurasian and Central Asian Students Association (DECASA)
description: When I came to Dartmouth for the first time in September 2024 from Uzbekistan, a lot of questions were thrown at me during the New Student Orientation: Do you speak Russian? Have you watched Borat? Is it true that your government is totalitarian?, and many more. I realized for many of my peers, I was the first person they’d meet from Central Asia, and that would carry a lot of expectations and perceptions by people in the West. I'm glad there are a lot of student organizations that are identity-based on campus. However, Iman (who’s a treasurer) and I feel there's no organization on campus for

name: Dartmouth Generations
description: Dartmouth Generations is an umbrella service organization that seeks to connect Dartmouth College students with independent elders, dementia patients, and care-givers in the Upper Valley. Through our sub-organizations, activities range widely, particularly noting conversation-based activities, art viewing and art therapy, and musical performances.

name: Dartmouth Gymnastics Club
description: The Dartmouth Gymnastics Club aims to unite Dartmouth students of all abilities through the practice of gymnastics. In increasing students’ mobility, strength, and agility, Dartmouth Gymnastics Club will work to make our campus healthier and help train any student interest in the sport. The club will be based on the pillars of discipline, strength, and fun which will both allow students to enjoy this amazing sport and spend time with other like-minded students motivated to become better all-around athletes.

name: Dartmouth Health Occupations Students of America
description: The purpose of Dartmouth HOSA is to develop leadership and technical health sciences and medical skills through participation in competitive events and a program of motivation, education, and recognition.

name: Dartmouth Humanitarian Engineering
description: Our primary goal is to organize Dartmouth students and give them the platform to take ideas that they are passionate about and turn them into projects that have tangible impacts on communities around the world.

name: Dartmouth Iberian Student Association
description: The Dartmouth Iberian Student Association (DISA) is a student community dedicated to learning about, celebrating, and sharing the cultures of the Iberian Peninsula, including Spain, Portugal, and Andorra. Through educational programming, cultural events, and open intellectual discussion, DISA supports students from the region and anyone interested in it, develops its members as leaders, and builds understanding between Iberian students and the wider Dartmouth community.

name: Dartmouth India Association
description: To foster a strong Indian community on campus and provide a support network for Indian students on campus, serve as a resource for incoming freshmen from India and provide opportunities for greater interaction between current students and Indian alumni.

name: Dartmouth Jiu Jitsu
description: To teach the fundamentals of Jiu Jitsu as a martial art and sport. The promotion of martial arts, self-defense, physical fitness, and the development of leadership and interpersonal skills among its members.

name: Dartmouth Leadership Attitudes and Behaviors
description: D-LAB (Dartmouth Leadership Attitudes and Behaviors) is a student-facilitated program designed for first-year students to discover the relationship between leadership and personal values. Through self-reflection and challenging discussion, students will soon find their place among the Dartmouth community and beyond. Through this program, participants explore their individual beliefs and values, and how these relate to who they are striving to be. They will also analyze the relationship between perception, intent, and impact and work to align their core values with the greater community. Partic

name: Dartmouth Magic: the Gathering Club
description: The Dartmouth Magic: The Gathering club aims to be a place for anyone interested to learn about and play Magic. We meet weekly on Thursday evenings and are open to all skill levels. Contact one of the officers if you would like to participate!

name: Dartmouth Mountain Biking Club
description: To foster and inclusive and supportive mountain biking community at Dartmouth College.

name: Dartmouth Nigerian Students Association
description: The mission of Dartmouth Nigerian Students Association is to offer a space for all students to learn more about Nigerian culture, history, politics, and hold space for conversation about life at Dartmouth as a Nigerian.

name: Dartmouth Organization of Rural Students
description: The primary aim of the Organization shall be to organize a community of Dartmouth College students who come from small town and rural backgrounds for the purpose of understanding and advancing issues related to rurality in higher education.

name: Dartmouth Pakistani Student Association
description: Dartmouth Pakistani Student Association is a cultural organization aimed at promoting Pakistani culture and heritage at Dartmouth as well as throughout the Upper Valley community

name: Dartmouth Peruvian Students Association
description: Our mission is to provide a space for Peruvian students at Dartmouth to celebrate their identities and their culture. Coming from a multicultural country, each student brings unique customs, traditions, and artistic expressions to the community. We empower students native to the country, Peruvian Americans, and non-Peruvians to learn about our rich history, taste our food, and experience our traditional practices.

name: Dartmouth Pokemon TCG Student Association
description: The Dartmouth Pokémon TCG Student Association intends to foster a community on campus for those interested in exploring the two sides of the TCG: the competitive card game and the collecting side. Through both in-person and zoom events, the student association hopes to further educate students about the Pokémon TCG, hone players' strategies to both playing and collecting, and explore the role of the Pokémon TCG in both Eastern and Western societies as the Pokémon Company International holds the most valuable intellectual property licenses on the planet.

name: Dartmouth Powerlifting Team
description: Dartmouth College Powerlifting (DPL) is an organization that promotes strength, health, and inclusivity in the fitness space. Founded in 2015, DPL welcomes all experience levels and genders to join our team.

name: Dartmouth Quant Students Club
description: The purpose of the Dartmouth Quant Students Club is to help students interested in the field of quantitative trading and market making gain exposure to the industry through weekly meetings and lectures, participation in trading competitions, recruitment activities, and guest panels with alumni speakers from various trading firms. The organization serves as a community for students interested in careers in proprietary or algorithmic trading, where people can discuss trading strategies, learn from upperclassmen who have internship or fulltime industry experience, and collaborate on competitions

name: Dartmouth Rude Mechanicals
description: The Rude Mechanicals are Dartmouth College's student-run Shakespeare company, the oldest student-run theater troupe at the college. We are a diverse set of individuals, all of whom have some attraction, be it literary, theatrical, or inexplicable, to the plays of William Shakespeare. We perform one show each term, and hold auditions at the beginning of fall and winter terms each year.

name: Dartmouth Rugby Football Club
description: Student leadership and life skill development via competitive excellence in rugby football.

name: Dartmouth Running Team
description: Mission: DRT is an inclusive club running team that seeks to provide a space for runners of all skills levels (from beginner to local elite) to foster a sense of community amongst their fellow Dartmouth peers, to access a network of running enthusiasts on campus, and to further develop their running ability.

name: Dartmouth Scandinavian Student Association
description: The Scandinavian Association is a student body organization at Dartmouth College. The Scandinavian Association is devoted to promoting awareness of the societies, cultures, and politics of the Scandinavian countries. It aims to serve as a platform for students and practitioners to understand and explore Scandinavian contributions to public policy and international affairs. In addition, the Scandinavian Association aims to connect students and practitioners to Scandinavian leaders, organizations, and enterprises in the United States and the Scandinavian countries.

name: Dartmouth Society of Computer Science Students
description: The specific purposes and objectives which the Organization shall be organized to pursue is the promotion of the study of Computer Science, through various events that can include but are not limited to team coding projects, educational speeches, and peer mentorship.

name: Dartmouth Student Architecture Club
description: The club's mission is to serve as a pre-professional organization for students interested in architecture by supporting career exploration, portfolio guidance, design workshops, and visits to architecture firms; and to foster design and architectural culture within the broader Dartmouth community through guest talks, campus tours, discussions, related events.

name: Dartmouth Student Cooking Club
description: The mission of Dartmouth Student Cooking Club is twofold. Firstly, we will explore and share world cultures through the medium of food and cooperative cooking. Secondly, we will encourage students to cook outdoors in a cooperative environment that promotes exploration, experimentation, and teamwork.

name: Dartmouth Student Elections
description: The Elections Planning and Advisory Committee (EPAC) is a student-run committee formed at the start of each winter term to oversee the campus-wide general election process for spring term. EPAC believes and supports the philosophy that an open, fair, and well-organized election process plays an essential part in strengthening our community and student governance at Dartmouth College. We strive to administer each election with the Principle of Community and this philosophy in mind.

name: Dartmouth Student Environmental Coalition
description: The mission of the Dartmouth Student Environmental Coalition is twofold. First, we bring together environmentally-oriented Dartmouth students and student groups, connecting them through events focused on issue awareness, networking, and pre-professional opportunities. Secondly, we seek to organize a mock NCF-Envirothon, an annual environmental competition for high schoolers around New England, to allow local youth to engage with the environmental sciences through hands-on learning. In line with the mission of the NCF-Envirothon and Dartmouth College, the Dartmouth Student Environmental Coaliti

name: Dartmouth Student Government
description: The official representative body for all undergraduates of Dartmouth College.

name: Dartmouth Student Map & Cartography Club
description: Dartmouth Map & Cartography Club's mission is to promote a love for geography and maps while also providing a space for students to socialize and relax. Whether it's drawing out fantasy maps from beloved novels, creating realistic and accurate globes, exploring the intersection of mapping and social justice (gerrymandering, school district boundaries, resource allocation, etc) or taking a more technology/GIS oriented approach, DMCC welcomes cartophiles of all varieties.

name: Dartmouth Student Mental Health Union
description: Our mission is to: - Provide and connect students with mental health information and resources - Advocate on behalf of students struggling with mental health concerns - Integrate diverse perspectives of mental health on campus through various programming - Bridge and maintain a constructive dialogue between the various mental health resources on campus Want to get involved? Here are a few ways to help make a difference: - Become a Mental Health Ambassador! Join the forefront of mental health advocacy and destigmatization on campus by attending a short training so that you can host information

name: Dartmouth Student Playwrights Collective
description: The Dartmouth Student Playwrights Collective is dedicated to fostering a supportive and creative community for undergraduate playwrights. We aim to empower students to write, workshop, and share original theatrical work, while creating space for artistic experimentation, collaboration, and new voices on campus.

name: Dartmouth Student QuizBowl Team
description: The Dartmouth Student QuizBowl Team prepares and fields teams of students to compete in trivia tournaments at the regional and national level.

name: Dartmouth Student Riftbound Club
description: The Riftbound Club aims to show people how to play riftbound and how to play a trading card game by providing a space, cards, and an area to learn Riftbound. We are committed to fostering an incluive space that allows people at dartmouth to feel welcome to do something they find joy in without getting judged for it. We will accomplish this by providing cards, teaching, and including everyone in the club’s activites

name: Dartmouth Student Rocket Team
description: We aspire to raise a generation of Dartmouth leaders in aerospace engineering through the design and fabrication of competitive, amateur rockets.

name: Dartmouth Students Demand Action
description: The purpose of the club is to advocate for gun safety and gun violence prevention through education and student engagment.

name: Dartmouth Students for Habitat for Humanity
Dartmouth Students for Water Safety
description: Dartmouth Students for Water Safety is dedicated to reducing preventable water-related deaths and injuries within the Dartmouth community through education, awareness, and peer-to-peer engagement. We are committed to equipping Dartmouth students with the knowledge and skills to make safer decisions around water: from understanding the deadly combination of alcohol and swimming, to recognizing the hidden dangers of breath-holding and cold water shock. Our mission is grounded in the belief that awareness saves lives, and that every preventable loss represents a failure we have the power to corre

name: Dartmouth Students Miniature Crafts Club
description: The Dartmouth Students Miniature Crafts Club is for undergraduate students at Dartmouth that enjoy creating hands-on crafts on a small scale. We aim to create an inviting and relaxing environment where students can find community and creative inspiration for weekly projects. We will lead students in unique projects and encourage intellectual creativity.

name: Dartmouth Taiwanese Student Association
description: DTA serves as a forum for students, faculty and community members who share a special interest in the political, social and cultural issues in Taiwan and aims to increase awareness for Taiwan on the Dartmouth campus.

name: Dartmouth Turkish Student Association
description: This organization aims to provide a network and community for Turkish and Turkish-American students and people interested in Turkish culture at Dartmouth College.

name: Dartmouth Undergraduate Biology Society
description: The specific purposes and objectives which the Organization shall be organized to pursue include building interest in and appreciation for the biological sciences at Dartmouth, fostering connections among undergraduates with a passion for biology, discussing new discoveries in the various sub-fields of biology, helping students discover research and extracurricular opportunities aligned with their interests at Dartmouth, and inspiring students to become future leaders in the life sciences. We welcome all students who are interested in biology - there is no requirement to be a biology major or

name: Dartmouth Undergraduate Biotechnology Association
description: The Dartmouth Undergraduate Biotechnology Association bridges the worlds of science and business by connecting students with the people, ideas, and opportunities shaping the future of biotechnology. Through networking, education, and professional development, and increasing collaboration with Dartmouth's graduate schools, we empower undergraduates to explore careers across the biotech ecosystem and position Dartmouth as a leader at the intersection of life sciences and innovation.

name: Dartmouth Undergraduate Climate Corps

description: To welcome players of every experience level to our fun-loving, competitive team! Practice as a team and travel to tournaments on the weekends, as well as create an inclusive social space outside of practice.
